programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Errand
programme.desc: When a young woman vanishes after stepping out to buy salad dressing, police try to provide answers to her fiancé and family.

programme.title: On the Case: Path of Tears
programme.desc: A 14-year-old girl is killed while walking her dog on a popular community bike trail.

programme.title: On the Case: Screams for Justice
programme.desc: The eyewitness accounts of neighbors may help or hinder investigators as they seek to solve the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: On the Case: Darkness in The Desert
programme.desc: Paula Zahn investigates the story of a Las Vegas starlet who mysteriously vanished during a visit to a local spy store.

programme.title: On the Case: Pattern of Violence
programme.desc: A 22 year old real estate agent is discovered strangled to death inside a model home she was trying to sell.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Paper Trail
programme.desc: The police follow a trail of emails, hoping it will lead them to a 38-year-old woman's vicious killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Tracks of a Killer
programme.desc: Police retrace a young woman's final movements with hope that it will lead them straight to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery In The Desert
programme.desc: When an innocent couple is murdered execution style in the Arizona desert it marks the beginning of a 50 year search for the truth. Who really killed them and why? After decades of investigation the controversial case remains shrouded in mystery

programme.title: On the Case: Sirens in the Night
programme.desc: Paula takes a look at the shocking discovery of a mysterious young woman who is found in the ashes of a fire.

programme.title: On the Case: Heartbreak in the Heartland
programme.desc: A quiet Midwestern community is rocked by a gruesome triple homicide. The unspeakable tragedy robs one man of his mother, grandmother and 5 year old son.

programme.title: On the Case: Trail of Betrayal
programme.desc: After missing newlyweds are found murdered, family members and friends point fingers at each other, leading investigators to believe someone close to the victims is responsible for their deaths.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Betrayal
programme.desc: A beloved father of two is executed after a friendly poker game. Were the stakes too high? Or would police find the truth much closer to home?

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Riddle
programme.desc: Nine days after 11-year-old Mary Stiles goes missing while trick-or-treating, a letter arrives at the police station leading investigators to Stiles' body; then, investigators must decipher a series of riddles before the killer strikes again.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Dance
programme.desc: A woman's walk home from a night out at a dance club ends in a brutal murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Stabbed in the Heart
programme.desc: A beloved mother of four is stabbed to death in her bathroom. A mysterious v shaped wound on her forehead finally leads police to her killer decades later.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder at Sunrise
programme.desc: A beautiful young mother is found murdered while walking her dogs. Investigators suspect her killer is someone she knew. Twenty-six years latter police make an arrest but is he the right man?

programme.title: On the Case: Left in the Dark
programme.desc: When a beautiful young graduate student is found stabbed to death, detectives must determine if the murder was a crime of passion or a brutal attack by a violent intruder.

programme.title: On the Case: Deceiving Appearances
programme.desc: Police suspect a mysterious double homicide is not what it appears to be.

programme.title: On the Case: Blood and Betrayal
programme.desc: A military police officer is found murdered in her own home, sending police on a twisted journey for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: A Long Journey To Justice
programme.desc: When a young college student is found murdered on the side of road, it is the start of a tormenting 26 year journey to justice for her family.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Transatlantic Crossing
programme.desc: The Turkey crew makes the critical jump over the North Atlantic. But en route to Portugal, one crew is forced to turn back.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Strip
programme.desc: Mechanic Jimmy is sent to a northern mining camp to create an ice landing strip on a remote lake where AJ will have to land a DC-3 and the much bigger C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Big Deal
programme.desc: When a power failure leaves Rankin Inlet exposed to the brutal northern elements, captain Justin races to deliver an emergency generator. Ramp hand Jeremy tries to move ahead of co-worker Audrey by training a new hire from India to replace him.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Jam
programme.desc: After taking command of an intense airlift, and dealing with the ugliest Electra load he's ever seen, Scott takes a scary fall on the icy tarmac.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Suspension
programme.desc: A furious Joe fights against a federal suspension that will prevent him from carrying passengers for the first time in 20 years. It's also a setback for Jeremy and the other rampies, which takes a turn for the worse with an unexpected injury.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Storm
programme.desc: Buffalo's Electra aircraft is hammered by rough winds up the Mackenzie Valley. In Hay River, a rookie crew faces the worst ice storm in years and one rampie has a tough go trying to fit in at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cold Start
programme.desc: Mikey links up with Chris Hadfield aboard the International Space Station. Problems mount while trying to get a frozen DC-4 airborne. A landing gear collapse on the runway sends the entire crew scrambling.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The River Lift
programme.desc: A vital ferry link is down, so Buffalo mounts an all-out campaign to airlift 100,000lbs of essential goods across the Mackenzie River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Very Buffalo Christmas
programme.desc: A week before Christmas, Buffalo agrees to lend a hand to an RCMP initiative to fly toys to isolated communities in the north. But a series of problems with the Electra leave the company in a jam.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Air Show
programme.desc: Joe flies with the Snowbirds during the Hamilton air show and later teaches Mikey to fly. A surprise departure shakes up Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Sunk
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey hire a helicopter for a salvage mission to retrieve the rare tailpiece from a Lockheed 10-A that crashed in the Yellowknife woods forty years ago.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Breakdown
programme.desc: Co-pilot Graeme's fumbles his Electra training landings. Chris stresses over his C-46 check ride. Adam rescues a stranded C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: 40/40/40
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot Scott faces his worst nightmare when a faltering Curtiss C-46 Commando engine and low fog force a scary landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Aussie Ace
programme.desc: The Electra returns from repairs and the crew takes it right back to the ice strip that it set off from before the crash landing last year. Tyler works up the courage to confront Joe about a big decision. A hotshot Australian pilot tries to earn a job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Crash
programme.desc: After thousands of hours of painstaking preparation and dangerous flying, a terrible accident devastates the waterbomber crew in Turkey - and everyone at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Target Practice
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey head to England to bring home a new plane. Devan does target-practice in the DC-4.James builds a Buffalo-style soapbox racer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Arnie Calls It
programme.desc: While training waterbomber captains for the upcoming fire-fighting season, Chief Pilot Arnie makes a surprising decision. AJ becomes a DC-4 captain and ponders whether to accept a promotion.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Second Chances
programme.desc: Rookie pilot Jeff nearly runs off the runway. Prefkar learns to play hockey but drops the ball at Buffalo and Joe goes on a date with a real dog.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
programme.desc: Metal Victorian-era burial casket; 1870s glass fire extinguisher grenades; a mechanical 1896 handcrafted Chicago fire station alarm box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Auction Hunters, Ink.
programme.desc: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Juleenglen
programme.desc: Den gode samaritaner Sarah Fitzpatrick er ude for en dødsulykke lige inden jul, og befinder sig pludselig i lobbyen ved porten til Himlen. Hun er sikker på at blive lukket ind, og bliver chokeret, da hun finder ud af at hendes navn ikke er på listen.

programme.title: Under the Christmas Tree
programme.desc: Alma Beltran skal overtage sin families 100 år gamle virksomhed, men Alma er en stædig traditionalist, der helst ikke vil have råd fra den virksomhedskonsulent, som hendes forældre har hyret.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En kommunaldirektør får hjælp af sin barndomsven til at arrangere byens julevelgørenhedsarrangement, og samtidigt forsøger hun at splejse ham sammen med sin nære veninde.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: Beckys juleønske er, at hendes familie for én gangs skyld vil høre på hende. Men så begynder alle hendes tanker og frustrationer at vælte ud, da hun ufrivilligt begynder at fortælle alle, hvad hun virkelig tænker.

programme.title: A Christmas Star
programme.desc: En astronom forudsiger, at der vil forekomme en ny meteorregn over en lille by, men hun må overtale de lokale til at hjælpe til med forberedelserne til sin opdagelse på bekostning af en juletradition.

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: Charlotte ender i koma efter en ulykke, men hendes sjæl er vågen. Inden en afstemning om et ejendomsprojekt skal hun få sin by og bygherren til at skifte mening, mens ingen kan se eller høre hende.

programme.title: Much Ado About Christmas
programme.desc: Efter at Haley er blevet såret af utallige bejlere, falder Claud for hende uden at kende hendes sande identitet. Men da denne sandhed uundgåeligt kommer frem, bringer det romancen i fare.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy sælger sin afdøde tantes hjælpeorganisation til den tilstødende virksomhedsejer Adam. Men Otto, som har været frivillig på stedet, vil gerne afholde en sidste velgørende julemiddag.

programme.title: Gift før jul
programme.desc: Carrie har dedikeret hele sit liv til sin fars virksomhed og har ikke meget tid til et socialt liv. Men så bestemmer bedstemorens testamente, at virksomheden går til den søster, der gifter sig først.

programme.title: Juleminder
programme.desc: Da Noelle arver sin afdøde mors hus, opdager hun at moren havde ansat Dave til at dekorere huset i julen. Han overbeviser hende om at fortsætte traditionen, og hun begynder at finde glæden ved julen.

programme.title: A Christmas... Present
programme.desc: Maggie fejrer jul med sin bror Paul og hans datter, efter at hans kone døde for nylig. Det får hende til at indse, hvad der mangler i hendes liv.

programme.title: NCIS: Trosspring
programme.desc: Selvmord forvandles til mord, da NCIS-teamet forsøger at tale en flådeofficer fra at springe i døden.

programme.title: NCIS: Kimære
programme.desc: Imens de efterforsker et mystisk dødsfald på havet, finder NCIS-teamet ud af, at de selv svæver i livsfare.

programme.title: NCIS: Rekviem
programme.desc: Da Gibbs går med til at hjælpe sin datters barndomsven, som døde for 15 år siden, finder han sig fanget i en følelsesbetonet sjælerejse til hans fortid, som fører til en chokerende og neglebidende konklusion.

programme.title: NCIS: Udpeget mål
programme.desc: NCIS-teamets efterforskning af mordet på en flådeadmiral tager en uventet og følelsesmæssig drejning, da de møder en kvinde, der søger efter sin savnede mand, en politisk flygtning fra Afrika.

programme.title: NCIS: Savnet og fundet
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet babysitter en 9-årig dreng hvis far har forbindelse til et uopklaret mord.

programme.title: NCIS: Fysisk afstraffelse
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet betaler en høj pris, da de forsøger at finde en marinesoldat, som menes stadig at befinde sig i Irak.

programme.title: NCIS: Stammer
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker en sag om en muslimsk marinesoldat, som findes død nær en moské, der mistænkes for at rekruttere terrorister.

programme.title: NCIS: Overvågning
programme.desc: Da en avanceret flåderadar forsvinder, overvåger NCIS-teamet en lagerbygning for at fange en mistænkt tyv, men de bevidner et mord i stedet.

programme.title: NCIS: Hundetegn
programme.desc: Da NCIS-teamet efterforsker et offer, der blev flænset til døde af en hund, sætter Abby sin karriere på spil for at bevise hundens uskyld og redde hans liv.

programme.title: NCIS: Interne affærer
programme.desc: Da liget af våbenhandleren La Grenouille dukker op, efterforsker FBI NCIS-teamet for mordet på ham, og Jenny Shepard bliver den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: NCIS: I krigszonen
programme.desc: Da et morterangreb i Bagdad ender som en mordefterforskning, sendes to medlemmer af NCIS-teamet til Irak for at opklare sagen.

programme.title: NCIS: Rekyl
programme.desc: Zivas undercoveropgave tager en chokerende og dødelig drejning, da en seriemorder, hun har sporet, mistænker hende.

programme.title: NCIS: Genkendt
programme.desc: Jimmy Palmer bliver mål for en mystisk morder, som kun han kan genkende.

programme.title: NCIS: Dommedag, Del I
programme.desc: Hele teamets skæbne hænger i en tynd tråd, da de jagter en, der myrdede en af deres egne.

programme.title: NCIS: Dommedag, Del II
programme.desc: Hele teamets skæbne hænger i en tynd tråd, da de jagter en, der myrdede en af deres egne.

programme.title: NCIS: Topsikkert
programme.desc: En flådekommandør dør omboard på Air Force One. Agenter fra NCIS beslutter at tage undersøgelsen i egen hånd og tvinger også Secret Service Agent Kate Todd til at hjælpe.

programme.title: NCIS: Ladt i stikken
programme.desc: Under en træningsøvelse åbner en marines faldskærm ikke, og han styrter ned i en parkeret bil. NCIS-teamet ankommer til scenen og skal afgøre, om marinesoldatens død var et tilfælde eller et mord.

programme.title: NCIS: Søulk
programme.desc: Da en Navy commanders lig vasker op på land sammen med ligene af to narkokurerer, nægter Gibbs at tro, at den dræbte sømand var korrupt.

programme.title: NCIS: De Udødelige
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet undersøger, da en sømands lig findes på havets bund klædt i hvidt med et ceremonielt sværd. De opdager, at han var afhængig af et rollespil i stil med Wizards and Warriors.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: I denne timelange specialepisode genoplever Maci og vennerne de sidste 6 år af Macis liv, og ser på højdepunkterne fra 16 and Pregnant og Teen Mom, mens de snakker om, hvor svært det er at vokse op foran et publikum.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Lauren Conrad jonglerer sin designeruddannelse, et krævende praktikantophold og en uforudsigelig bofælle, der saboterer hendes jobevent, så hun lærer hurtigt, at alt er større i L.A., inklusive hendes problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Da Heidi får et interview til et 'drømmejob', der får hende til at overveje at droppe skolen, indser Lauren, at hun og Heidi er på vej i forskellige retninger.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren væk på et ærinde til New York, og da hun vender tilbage til L.A. venter der en stor overraskelse fra hendes fortid. Heidi indser, at arbejdet som festarrangør ikke er en stor fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eks fra Laguna Beach, dukker op i hendes liv igen, indser Lauren, at hun måske ikke er kommet sig over ham. I sit nye job spørger Heidi om prisen er for høj.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Som militær entusiast fra Colorado Springs, sælger Ebony sin ROTC-uniform for at købe graviditetstøj. Hun og hendes kæreste Josh havde planlagt at melde sig til luftvåbenet, men både det og deres eksamen bliver måske forpurret af en ny baby.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Sydstatsskønheden Whitney er fra den lille by Georgia, og hun er familiens baby. Men da hendes mor også er gravid, bliver huset hurtigt overfyldt, og Whitney og hendes kæreste Weston må finde en måde at flytte ud og blive deres egen familie.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: 16-årige Catelynn er fra en lille by i Michigan, og hun er den fornuftige i en ellers temmelig temperamentsfuld familie. Med støtte fra sin kæreste Tyler tager hun en stor beslutning og forfølger tanken om adoption uden hendes forældres tilladelse.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Goin' South
programme.desc: Jersey Shore banden tager til Miami! Imens at The Situation, Snooki, Pauly D og JWOWW tager en road trip ned til østkysten, hopper resten af gruppen på et fly for at tage vinteren i syden.

programme.desc: Sammi prøver at finde ud af hvad Ronnie lavede på natklubben aftenen før, men der er ingen som siger noget. Da Angelina afbryder Paulys game, ser vi en helt ny side, af en ellers meget rolig Pauly D!

programme.desc: Angelina må sluge sin stolthed og sige undskyld til pigerne. I huset hygger The Situation, Vinny og Pauly D sig i boblebadet, mens Ronnie fortsætter med at krybe bag Sammi ryg.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Goodbye Girl
programme.desc: Bud tries to ruin Kelly's new job at the TV World theme park.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Gas Station Show
programme.desc: Al finds himself with the gas station blues when he can't pay his bill and is forced to work at one.

programme.title: Vore værste år: England Show I
programme.desc: The Bundy's win a trip to England -- with a deadly catch.

programme.title: Vore værste år: England Show II
programme.desc: The Bundy's arrive in Lower Uncton, England, where the townspeople are plotting to kill them.

programme.title: Vore værste år: England Show III
programme.desc: Al fights in an old fashioned joust to save his family.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: When Peg's 5-year-old nephew Seven is abandoned at the Bundy doorstep by his loser parents, Peg and Al decide to keep him, much to their kids' dismay.

programme.title: Vore værste år: T R A Something, Something Spells Tramp
programme.desc: When Kelly's date gives her an ultimatum, she finds herself stranded but not alone on a deserted road 15 miles outside Chicago. Meanwhile, Peg tries to put some spice back into her marriage by spending Saturday night "communicating" with Al.
programme.sub-title: T R A Something, Something Spells Tramp

programme.title: Vore værste år: Every Bundy Has A Birthday
programme.desc: When Seven can't remember his birthday, Peggy assigns him one, selecting the next day, which also happens to be Al's birthday. The family decides to go to the town park to celebrate, only to find it's been rented by a rich, snobby family.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Al On The Rocks
programme.desc: When Peggy panics over Seven's sneezes, she begins piling up medical bills, forcing Al to take on a second job as a "topless" bartender.

programme.title: Vore værste år: What I Did For Love
programme.desc: Peg tries everything in the book to renew Al's romantic interest in her -- up to and including promises of five-course meals.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Frat Chance
programme.desc: Desperate for a date, Bud founds his own community college fraternity in his garage.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Chicago Wine Party
programme.desc: With the elections coming up, Al convinces his family to register and vote for the first time in an effort to stop a proposed tax on beer. When the tax increase passes, Al leads an angry protest to overturn the bill.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Kelly Doesn't Live Here Anymore
programme.desc: When Al can't afford to pay the bills, he convinces Kelly to get a job. Finding employment as a waitress at a burger joint, Kelly realizes why mother Peg has never worked a day in her life.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Rock Of Ages
programme.desc: Al meets rock heroes John Sebastian, Peter Noone, Mark Lindsay, Robby Krieger, Richie Havens and Spencer Davis. Mistaking him for a fellow rocker, the musicians convince Al to perform with them at a benefit.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Death Of A Shoe Salesman
programme.desc: While shopping for a burial plot for the family, Al and Peg discover they don't have enough money, so they have to be buried in the same casket.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Old College Try
programme.desc: Bud's big plans to move into his college dorm are destroyed when Al and Peg manage to get their hands on his scholarship money and go on a shopping spree. Broke and dormless, Bud is forced back into the Bundy household.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Christmas
programme.desc: Al does his yearly pre-Christmas inspection of the family and can find they've done nothing wrong, which means he has to buy them presents, but he has to take a job as a Department Store Santa to pay for the gifts.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Wedding Show
programme.desc: As the Bundys prepare to attend their cousin Jimmy's wedding, everything begins to go wrong. Al can't find his suit, Peg can't get her make-up right, Kelly and the bridesmaids think they have on the wrong dresses and Bud gets caught with the bride.

programme.title: Vore værste år: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This
programme.desc: Al takes a fishing trip alone, only to have Peg and Marcy show up and spoil his vacation.
programme.sub-title: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This

programme.title: Vore værste år: Heels On Wheels
programme.desc: Kelly buys a motorcycle to put some fun back into her life, but disaster strikes when Al decides to take the bike out for a spin.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Mr. Empty Pants
programme.desc: Peggy's unflattering cartoon makes Al a reluctant celebrity.

programme.title: Vore værste år: You Can't Miss
programme.desc: Bud goes on a dating game for "nerds."

programme.title: Vore værste år: Peggy And The Pirates
programme.desc: While reading a romance novel, Peg fantasizes that she is a lady in distress and Al is the pirate who saves her

programme.title: Vore værste år: Go For The Old
programme.desc: Al becomes obsessed with his age after a theater cashier gives him a senior citizen's discount.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Unalful Entry
programme.desc: Al becomes a local hero when he stands up to a burglar.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Movie Show
programme.desc: Kelly gets an unpleasant surprise when the family takes her to a movie on her birthday.

programme.title: Vore værste år: 'Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: When Peg complains about Al's lovemaking to the girls at the beauty parlor, he becomes the laughingstock of the town.

programme.title: Vore værste år: 'Tis Time To Smell The Roses
programme.desc: Peg spends all of Al's early retirement money and forces him to go back to work.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Old Insurance Dodge
programme.desc: When Al's Dodge is stolen, he learns it is only worth $100, and he decides to add a few priceless items to the list of things missing from his trunk.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Wedding: Repercussions
programme.desc: When Jimmy, the Bundy's relative, learns that his new bride slept with someone the day of their wedding, his temper explodes and a guilty Bud runs for cover.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Proposition
programme.desc: Coco, a cosmetic millionairess and former girlfriend of Al's, makes a truly indecent proposal by offering Peggy $500,000 for one night of passion with Al.

programme.title: Vore værste år: A Tisket, A Tasket, Can Peggy Make A Basket
programme.desc: Al gets a pair of tickets to a big basketball game.
programme.sub-title: A Tisket, A Tasket, Can Peggy Make A Basket

programme.title: Vore værste år: Hood In The Boyz
programme.desc: When Al finds out one of his high school girlfriends is experiencing gang trouble in the old neighborhood, he enlists the help of his football pals for a confrontation that pits youth against experience.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Proud To Be Your Bud
programme.desc: Bud's latest attempts to impress women fail miserably, causing him such embarrassment that he confines himself to the basement. But when his "cool" alter ego appears, Bud learns the secrets of gaining adoration.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Luck Of The Bundys
programme.desc: Peg checks Al's horoscope and insists he's due for a stroke of good luck. But when good things actually start happening, Al gets a shrinking feeling that his luck won't last.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Banking On Marcy
programme.desc: When Marcy's superiors at the bank ask her to deliver bad news at a shareholder's meeting, she calls a radio therapist who suggests she focus on sex to overcome her fear of speaking in public -- advice that leads to disastrous results.

programme.desc: Fran spends her first Christmas with the Sheffields.

programme.desc: Fran contends with Maxwell's old nanny.

programme.desc: Fran's birthday gift leads to a date with a handsome mortician.

programme.desc: Fran and Maxwell clash over Grace's school pageant.

programme.title: The Nanny: Schlepped Away

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: My Better Halves

programme.title: The Cooler

programme.title: Road Less Traveled
programme.desc: Countrysangerinden Charlotte vender tilbage til Tennessee, inden hun bliver gift. Da hun møder sin ungdoms kærlighed, bliver der noget levende, og hun sætter spørgsmålstegn ved alt.

programme.title: Bel Ami

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen

programme.desc: Charlotte og Mikkel bor i så lille en lejlighed, at brusekabinen skal tømmes for ting hver gang de skal bade. Men nu vil de meget gerne flytte lidt ud af byen med deres søn.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 304
programme.desc: Pernille og Nicklas fra Odense bor så småt, at hvis man skal have lidt privatliv, er der kun toilettet at ty til. Nicklas drømmer om få et køkken med mange blus og to ovne, så han kan lave mere mad.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 305
programme.desc: Wendy og Jesper fra Kalundborg bor i forvejen godt i en lejlighed, der har en formidabel udsigt, men en kommende familieforøgelse gør, at de skal finde noget der er større.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 306
programme.desc: Jonas og Louise bliver rystede, da de ser hvilket hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen er denne gang kommet på overarbejde for at prøve at imødekomme parrets ønsker.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 307
programme.desc: Mads og Mia vil gerne flytte udenfor byen – men ikke helt på landet. Med Tobias og Mads´ hjælp køber de en bolig, der har lige nøjagtig alt det, de ikke bryder sig om.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 401
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blinde er tilbage, og i sæsonpremieren møder vi Tine og Lars, som har svimlende otte millioner at købe hus og renovere for. Det store budget har dog ikke hjulpet dem hidtil – kan eksperterne?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 402
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blindes eksperter kommer på arbejde i Hørning, hvor præsten og hendes familie bor til leje i et rækkehus og gerne vil videre – men bliver skræmte af tilstandsrapporter og spidse tage.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om at skifte deres 60 kvm lejebolig på Nørrebro ud med en murermestervilla i Hillerød. Men de fortryder bittert, at de lod eksperterne hjælpe, da de ser det hus, pengene rakte til.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små børn – og en drøm om at flytte sammen med bedsteforældrene. Så eksperterne skal på jagt efter et hus, der kan rumme to familier, med plads til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 406
programme.desc: Anne Sofie og Paw har ikke plads nok i den lille Frederiksberg-lejlighed efter familieforøgning. Men kravene til drømmehuset er tårnhøje, så selv med 7 millioner til køb, kan de ikke finde det rigtige.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen falder til jorden med et brag. Eksperterne kommer på ekstraarbejde, før det – forhåbentlig – ender med, at den lille familie flytter ind i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to børn har overtaget hjemmet, og der er legetøj overalt. Løsningen er en større bolig, men det er ikke lykkedes parret at finde det rigtige hus. Nu går eksperterne i gang, men det bliver ikke nemt.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte deres rækkehus i troen på, at de nok hurtigt ville finde det rette hus. Men nej. Parret er superkræsne, og har høje krav. Kan eksperterne skabe det hjem, Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Hjælp, jeg ser rødt
programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde. Da han kommer derud, udsættes han ved et uheld for et radioaktivt stof...

programme.desc: I et rige fyldt med magi og svig kæmper den frygtløse lovløse Diana mod den ondskabsfulde Lord Roland. Sammen med sine brødre og den unge ridder Tyrion begiver hun sig ud på et farligt eventyr for at redde prinsessen og riget.

programme.desc: Den charmerende og dovne svindler, Joe Thanks - også kaldet Nobody (Terence Hill), rejser fra by til by og optræder som en anden gøgler med mere eller mindre realistiske revolverdueller.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 408
programme.desc: Vanløse, tæt på København ligger Restaurant Bella, en indisk restaurant. Eller -det er hvad Bo Bech tror, det er. Men da han ankommer viser det sig også at være en grillbar, kiosk og bar, som serverer kinesisk mad.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 405
programme.desc: I Grenå, tæt på havnen, ligger Restaurant Dagens ret, det har den gjort i halvandet år, men det er svært for ejeren Claus Lyster Nielsen, at få det til at hænge sammen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 402
programme.desc: For godt et år siden åbnede Restaurant Roseline, som ligger midt i Århus, tæt ved åen og alle caféerne. Men - kun ganske få lægger vejen forbi den vietnamesiske restaurant.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 306
programme.desc: I foråret 2010 overtog familien Glisbo Roslev Kro. Tilværelsen som kroejere skulle have været Tinna og Marks vej til det gode liv – men sådan er det langt fra gået.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 407
programme.desc: På Sønderborg Kaserne står Morten i køkkenet og det har han gjort i 4 år. Når sergenteleverne kommer hjem fra øvelse, er de sultne og skal bare have noget godt mad. Det mener, Bo Bech ikke de får.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 601
programme.desc: Thomas Castberg er taget til Nordjylland, hvor alt er gået i stå i køkkenet på Kongerslev Kro. Krofatter Morten vil gerne have spisende gæster, men kroen er efterhånden kun et værtshus.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 705
programme.desc: I de smukkeste omgivelser i Korsør lystskov ligger restaurant Sommerlyst. Stedet er drevet af Jesper og Yvonne, der 4 måneder inde i deres forpagtning, allerede er ved at kaste håndklædet i ringen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 604
programme.desc: Brasilianske Jacira har drevet sin lille restaurant, O Tempo, i tre år. Og i de tre år har hun ikke fået løn. Det kan ikke blive ved med at gå, men spørgsmålet er, om Thomas på bare fem dage kan redde restauranten.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 106
programme.desc: På Nørrebro i København ligger én af Danmarks eneste afrikanske restauranter. Kokken og ejeren Kwame er selv ghaneser – og en stolt madentusiast. Fra sit køkken drømmer han om at give danskerne en unik bid af Afrika.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 603
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt på den sicilianske restaurant i Hillerød, når Lilo skiftevis kaster med gryder i køkkenet og spiller harmonika - og hans hustru, Anja, styrer slagets gang i restauranten.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 706
programme.desc: Restaurant Limone drives af ægteparret Johnny og Helle. Restauranten, der ligger inde i en biograf, kæmper med at få gæster til at komme og spise - og ikke bare gå i biografen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 404
programme.desc: Den mexicanske Restaurant Caramba ligger idyllisk ved Nyborgs gamle slot og gadekær. Ejeren Kim har haft restauranten i 12 år, han elsker det mexicanske køkken og kan holde lange foredrag om chilien. Men han er gået i stå.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 205
programme.desc: Antonino åbnede Da Vinci i Hadsund - og det er en succes, Bo Bechankommer til. Det er en helt ny og meget stor restaurant som tilbyder italiensk mad til borgerne i Hadsund stort set døgnet rundt. Og det er gået helt fantastisk.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 403
programme.desc: I Nykøbing Mors i Nordjylland ligger Restaurant Perlen, som er ejet af Ahmed Zeebar. Ahmed er uddannet kok, han elsker at lave mad og synes selv, han er god til det.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 109

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 606

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 411

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 410

programme.desc: A man tells deputies the pants he has on aren't his. Officers are called to the scene of men firing an ak-47. A nervous driver fesses up to the deputy who stopped him.

programme.title: COPS: What's Your Deductible?
programme.desc: Detectives chase a suspect who wrecks his car. Police are called when a man headbutts his neighbor. Officers tend to a woman punched in the face by her husband while on the bus.

programme.title: COPS: Wardrobe Malfunction
programme.desc: A suspect flees police in a truck over a misdemeanor traffic warrant. A man denies hitting his wife who has a bloody nose. A man denies ownership of his shorts when deputies find drugs in them.

programme.title: COPS: High Speed Golf
programme.desc: Deputies pursue a truck with a trailer full of golf carts. Police question a driver after finding a mask and handgun in his car. Officers are called to a traffic collision involving a semi and an SUV.

programme.title: COPS: Bumper Cars
programme.desc: A man rams his wife's car into his daughter's car. Deputies find a rifle in a suspect's car that was in a prior altercation. A man claims to run a travel business after cops find evidence of id theft.

programme.title: COPS: Doggie Dispute
programme.desc: Deputies pursue a man wanted in connection with a family violence call. Detectives are called to a dispute between neighbors over an unleashed dog.

programme.title: COPS: Rocks in my Socks
programme.desc: Deputies discover a purse and a sock containing paraphernalia during an arrest. Deputies pursue an intoxicated motorcyclist. A woman is suspected of stealing a cake.

programme.title: COPS: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deputies prevent the delivery of a pillow stuffed with drugs. A disabled woman calls the law when a father and son get into a fist fight. Deputies confront an intoxicated man riding a bike.

programme.title: COPS: Memory Loss
programme.desc: A man on parole dumps a stolen car and flees from officers on foot. A man denies stealing a wallet from a car with a smashed window. A hostile woman gives officers a false name.

programme.title: COPS: Up for Sainthood
programme.desc: Officers pursue two juveniles involved in a carjacking. Two men sitting in a truck are spotted hiding something in the console. A man claims he took drug paraphernalia from kids as a good samaritan.

programme.title: COPS: Beer Run
programme.desc: A carjacking results in a chase and a flipped vehicle. Suspects crash a truck after attempting to steal beer. A man attempts to swallow his drugs during a bust.

programme.title: COPS: Petrol Heist
programme.desc: Officers wrestle an uncooperative driver to the ground after a traffic stop. Deputies search for a man who sent threatening texts to his ex-girlfriend. Two suspects are caught stealing gas.

programme.title: COPS: Check Please!
programme.desc: Deputies confront an intoxicated man who threatened a restaurant owner. A man tells officers he can assault who he wants. Officers are called to an altercation over a sleeping bag and a backpack.

programme.title: COPS: Decorating Tips
programme.desc: Officers pursue an SUV on the freeway. Deputies are called when an agitated man armed with scissors tears up a trailer. A driver tells officers the illegal items found in his car was left by a friend.

programme.title: COPS: Hide and Go Porch
programme.desc: Officers engage in a car chase when they spot a possible robbery suspect. A man nicknamed "Danger" is tasered after assaulting several girls. Suspects bail from a vehicle and hide under a porch.

programme.title: COPS: Pub Rules
programme.desc: A prostitution sting leads police to uncover additional crimes . A prostitute tells deputies she wanted money to buy her daughter a birthday gift. Deputies are called to an assault at a pub.

programme.title: COPS: Alleycat
programme.desc: Officers search for a runaway suspect with a weapons charge. A man admits to having a large number of drugs during a traffic stop. Officers respond to a man with a gun in an alley.

programme.title: COPS: Victoria's New Secret
programme.desc: Deputies observe a woman stuff drugs into her bra. A mother attacks her daughter because she got married in Vegas. Officers are called when a woman is accused of stalking her friend.

programme.title: COPS: Apologies Detective
programme.desc: Officers hold a man under a car at gunpoint after a traffic stop. Officers are flagged down and directed to an arguing couple. A man apologizes to detectives for the illicit items they find.

programme.title: COPS: It's Laundry Day
programme.desc: Deputies detain a man when a gun falls from his pantleg. Deputies are called when a father spits on his son's girlfriend. Officers respond when a child is bitten by two large dogs.

programme.title: COPS: Nothing Upstairs
programme.desc: Officers pursue a motorcyclist driving erratically. Deputies find broken drug paraphernalia in a car when conducting a traffic stop. A man who beat up his girlfriend hides from officers in an attic.

programme.title: COPS: Follow Me to the River
programme.desc: A deputy jumps into a waterway to arrest a fleeing suspect. Officers respond to roommates in an argument. Officers are called when two crossdressers attack a group of women.

programme.title: COPS: Hiding the Evidence
programme.desc: A drug dealer swallows something suspicious as deputies move in to arrest him. Deputies pull over a father with his son in the car. A woman files a kidnapping report against her own boyfriend.

programme.title: COPS: Blame my Man
programme.desc: A man runs from police claiming he heard a gunshot. A woman lays the blame on her boyfriend. Officers confront a man who refuses to come down from a roof.

programme.title: COPS: My BFF Screwed Up
programme.desc: Officers respond to a call of a woman holding a loaded gun to her head. Officers kick in a door to halt an assault in progress. A woman driving a stolen vehicle claims it was purchased by a friend.

programme.title: COPS: Last Call Brawl
programme.desc: Deputies chase a man who flees a routine traffic stop. Deputies find drugs on a man who gives them an expired license. Officers respond to a man attacking several patrons in a bar.

programme.title: Frasier: Room Service
programme.desc: Et uventet besøg fra Lilith (gæstestjerne Bebe Neuwirth) rusker op i gamle passioner i Frasier og nye i Niles.

programme.title: Frasier: Beware of Greeks
programme.desc: Sparks flygter, da et familiebryllup genantænder en længe ulmnende strid mellem Frasier og hans hidsige græske tante Zora (gæstestjerne Patti LuPone).

programme.title: Frasier: The Perfect Guy
programme.desc: Radiostationen hyrer en smuk ny læge til at være vært på et radioprogram, man kan ringe ind til, men Frasier, der plejer sit mandlige ego, er besluttet på at funde en fel ved sin nye kollega, der ser ud til at være lidt 'for perfekt'.

programme.title: Frasier: Bad Dog
programme.desc: Da Bulldog uretmæssigt tager æren for at forpurre et røveri og redde Roz's liv, beslutter Fraiser sig for at få Bulldog til at 'gå til bekendelse'.

programme.title: Frasier: Frasier Gott a Have It
programme.desc: Frasiers er splittet mellem hans 'lyst' til sin seneste erobring, og erkendelsen af, at de ikke har noget tilfælles, bortset fra fantastisk sex.

programme.title: Frasier: First Date
programme.desc: Niles får Daphne til at hjælpe sig med at planlægge en falsk middagsaftale med en nabo, så hun ikke opdager, hvor meget han rent faktisk holder af hende.

programme.title: Frasier: Roz and the Schnoz
programme.desc: Roz bekymrer sig om sin nye babys skæbne, da hun opdager, at forældrene til babyens far har to af de største næser, hun nogensinde har set.

programme.title: Frasier: The Life of the Party
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles, der er desparate efter at finde kærligheden, går sammen om at lave en singlefest og ender med at kappes om opmærksomheden fra den samme kvinde.

programme.title: Frasier: Party Party
programme.desc: Frasier forsøger at være tre steder på én gang, da han forsøger at gøre sin kæreste, bror og far glade.

programme.title: Frasier: Sweet Dreams
programme.desc: Da Frasier går forrest i en protest, hvor man kræver bedre behandling af radiostationens medarbejdere, fyrer overhovedet i radiostationens moderselskab dem alle.

programme.title: Frasier: Good Grief
programme.desc: Da Frasier viser sig at benægter at have mistet sit job, går Niles, Roz og Martin sammen om at bringe ham tilbage til virkeligheden.

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Frasier fygter for idéen om at deltage i en high school-genforening, som altid synes at falde sammen med en nedtursperiode i hans liv

programme.title: Frasier: Dial M for Martin
programme.desc: Niles er ikke særlig begejsret ved udsigten til at hans far flytter ind - indtil det går op for ham, at Daphne er en del af pakken.

programme.title: Frasier: Hot Ticket
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles gør alt for at få fat i billetter til det hotteste teaterstykke i byen.

programme.title: Frasier: First Do No Harm
programme.desc: Frasier mistænker sin skønne nye kæreste for kun at udnytte ham til at få gratis psykologrådgivning.

programme.title: Frasier: The Secret Admirer
programme.desc: Frasier tror fejlagtigt, at han har en hemmelig beundrer, og bringer sit nye forhold i fare, idet han forsøger at fordoble fornøjelsen.

programme.title: Frasier: How to Bury a Millionaire
programme.desc: Efter Maris tilbageholder Niles' aktiver, er han tvunget til at fremleje sin luksuriøse lejlighed og flytte in i et 'budgetlejligheds'-kompleks.

programme.title: Frasier: The Seal Who Came to Dinner
programme.desc: En død sæl 'crasher' Niles' gourmetmiddagsselskab.
programme.sub-title: The Seal Who Came to Dinner

programme.title: Frasier: Roz A Loan
programme.desc: Frasier låner Roz 1.500 USD for at hjælpe hende igennem, indtil de får deres jobs tibage, og misbilliger så måden, hun bruger pengene på.

programme.title: Frasier: Merry Christmas Mrs. Moskowitz
programme.desc: Frasier agerer en jøde for at formilde sin nye kærestes mor.

programme.title: Frasier: The Good Samaritan
programme.desc: Frasier er den, der har brug for hjælp eft hans gode gerninger falder ham i ryggen.

programme.title: Frasier: Our Parents Ourselves
programme.desc: Frasier og Roz spiller Kirsten Giftekniv over for deres forældre - med katastrofale følger.

programme.title: Frasier: The Show Where Woody Shows Up
programme.desc: Cheers' bartender Woody Boyd bliver længere, end han er velkomen, da han besøger Seattle.
programme.sub-title: The Show Where Woody Shows Up

programme.title: Frasier: Three Valentines
programme.desc: På valentins dag er Niles, Frasier, Martin og Daphne på tre meget forskellige slags dates.

programme.title: Frasier: To Tell the Truth
programme.desc: Niles hyrer en aggressiv ny skilsmisseadvokat, som måske kan afskutte hans crush på Daphne, der har varet længe.

programme.title: Frasier: Decoys
programme.desc: Niles skaber hemmelige intriger for at ødelæge Daphnes nye affære med hans skilsmisseadvokat.

programme.title: Frasier: The Dinner Party
programme.desc: Frasiers planer om et elegant middagsselskab render ind i den ene forhindring efter den anden.

programme.title: Frasier: Taps at the Montana
programme.desc: Niles, der står over for at blive sat ud af sin snobbede lejerbestyrelse, laver en fest for at vinde deres gunst igen.

programme.title: Frasier: IQ
programme.desc: Søskenderivaliseringen mellem Frasier og Niles når nye højder, da de sammenligner IQ-point.

programme.title: Frasier: Dr. Nora
programme.desc: Frasier er skrækslagen, da en mildt talende kvindelig psykolog, han nødede stationen til at ansætte, viser sig at være en skrapt talende tyran.

programme.title: Frasier: When a Man Loves Two Women
programme.desc: Frasiers er spillet mellem at date sin gamle kæreste eller en frodig ny flamme.
programme.sub-title: When a Man Loves Two Women

programme.title: Frasier: Visions of Daphne
programme.desc: Til Niles store fornøjelse giver en serie synske åbenbaringer Daphne betænkeligheder omkring at gifte sig med Donny.

programme.title: Frasier: Shutout in Seattle (Part 1)
programme.desc: Niles, der er nedtrykt over Daphnes engagement, slår sig løs med en funky servitrice fra Café Nervosa.

programme.title: Frasier: Shutout in Seattle (Part 2)
programme.desc: Frasier, Martin, Nilesog Roz's kærlighedsliv falder sammen omkring dem.

programme.title: Frasier: The Three Faces of Frasier
programme.desc: Frasiers glæe over at få sin karikatur udstillet i et berømt lokalt attraktion forsvinder da han ser det meget lidt flatterendeportræt.

programme.title: Frasier: The Good Son (Pilot)
programme.desc: Psykiateren Frasier Crane vender tilbage til sin fødeby Seattle for at være vært på et radiotalkshow, men opdager snart, at han selv har brug for en psykiater, da hans handicappede far flytter ind.

programme.title: Frasier: Space Quest
programme.desc: Frasier er træt af manglen på privatliv både derhjemme og på jobbet, beslutter det er tid til, at faderen flytter ud.

programme.title: Frasier: Dinner At Eight
programme.desc: Det er et kulturet kultursammenstød, da Frasier og Niles mødes med deres far til en middag på hans yndlingsrestaurant.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: Fra føderationens start var hovedreglen klar. Ingen Starfleet-ekspedition må forstyrre den naturlige udvikling af andre civilisationer. Men Picard konfronteres nu med ordrer, der går imod den regel.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Kursen er sat mod en galakse med action og eventyr uden lige, mens kaptajn Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) og hans stjerneskibsbesætning kæmper mod en farlig modstander, som har en overraskende forbindelse til Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Da et uidentificeret objekt ødelægger de tre mægtige Klingon-krydsere vender kaptajn James T. Kirk (William Shatner) tilbage til det nyligt ombyggede U.S.S. Enterprise(tm) for at overtage kommandoen.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Det er 2200-tallet. Føderationens U.S.S. Enterprise er på en træingsopgave, og admiral James T. Kirk (William Shatner) har forsonet sig med, at inspektionen kan blive den sidste rumrejse i hans karriere. Men Khan er tilbage.

programme.title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirks sejr over Khan og oprettelsen af Genesis-planeten er tomme sejre. Spock er død, og McCoy bliver på uforklarlig vis drevet til vanvid. Så giver et overraskende besøg af Sarek, Spocks far, en opsigtsvækkende åbenbaring..

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Det er det 23. århundrede, og en rumvæsenmagt fordamper havene. For at redde menneskeheden må Kirk og hans besætning rejse tilbage til 1986, hvor de finder en verden fuld af Punk, Pizza og byttebusser, er vildfremmed for dem!

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Besætningen om bord på føderations stjerneskib Enterprise beordres til Nimbus III, den intergalaktiske fredsplanet. De må kun forhandle i en sag om kidnapning for blot at finde ud af, at kidnapperen er i familie med Spock.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Efter flere års krig forbereder føderationen og Klingon-imperiet en fredskonference, da et Klingon-skib næsten bliver ødelagt af et tilsyneladende angreb fra Enterprise. De to verdener ruster sig til deres endelige kamp.

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picards eneste håb for en fremtid hviler hos Nexus...og en legendarisk kaptajn fra fortiden.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mathilde Croguenne Case
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending \"Teknival\" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer among the 43,000 participants of this festival

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.
programme.sub-title: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Josiane Bézard Case
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case
programme.desc: On the evening of August 30st 2013, in a small village of Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, 52 years old, reports his wife missing to the police. Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Émilie Godest Case
programme.desc: On November 9th 2007, around 11:30PM, aid arrives on the scene of an accident at the exit of Chateney-en-France.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)
programme.desc: On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood.
programme.sub-title: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valerie Bary Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Ordeal of Schoolgirl (Perrais case)
programme.desc: Laetitia Perrais, 18, a trainee hotel waitress, vanishes after evening service.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Ordeal of Schoolgirl (Perrais case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Triple Murders in Vise
programme.desc: On May 17th 2005, a body is discovered in a forest of Sucy-en-Brie; Christophe Belle, 40 years old, a renowned pastry cook.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaf Case)
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to Karine Schaaff, 16, is found abandoned by the side of a road in Moselle.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaf Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Audrey Jouannet Case
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Sylvie Darcy Case
programme.desc: On February 26th 2012, in the Yevelines. Around 11PM policemen are called for an assault in a parking lot in the forest of Saint-Lambet-des-Bois.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.
programme.sub-title: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)
programme.desc: On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up.
programme.sub-title: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 103
programme.desc: Ivana, der ikke bare endte med at bruge en million kroner i USA, men hvor lægerne tog en fatal beslutning under hendes narkose, Lotte, der har forsøgt at skjule sit ødelagte maveskind bag tatoveringer.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 310
programme.desc: Vi møder bodybuilderen Ulla, der ønskede sig bryster, som skulle få hende til at se kvindelig ud, men som nu har fået så store implantater, at hun har svært ved at træne.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 905
programme.desc: Melanie og Monas operationer hæmmer dem i at være intime med deres allerkæreste. Karina fik opgraderet til Barbie-bryster, hvorfra der nu siver hytteost-lignende materie ud af brystvorterne.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 504
programme.desc: Efter et større vægttab har Birgit store mængder overskydende hud på maven og hun beslutter sig derfor at få fortaget en hudreduktion, men hun var knap nok udskrevet, før hun vidste, at noget var galt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 601
programme.desc: Charlotte får i 2009 fjernet sine implantater i brysterne på grund af komplikationer. Efterfølgende får hun støbt en silikoneprotese, som kan kompensere for den varierende størrelse på brysterne, men protesen er både generende og upraktisk.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 904
programme.desc: Jeanne får uønskede og sårende tilråb for sine nye bryster, og de hæmmer hende fra at leve et normalt liv. Gitte skammer sig over sine ben og bruger enormt meget tid og energi på at kamuflere dem.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 506
programme.desc: I 2010 får Birthe indsat saltvandsimplanater i stedet for de almindelige silikoneimplantater. 5 år senere vågner hun op til et skræmmende syn - hendes ene implantat er væk.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 604
programme.desc: 61-årige Lis har gennem livet ønsket at ændre på sine små bryster . Derfor vælger at få foretaget en brystforstørrende operation, men kort tid efter oplever hun, at det har konsekvenser for hendes sexliv.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 703
programme.desc: Den tidligere burlesque-danser Grethe fik i 2011 fjernet begge sine bryster som led i hendes behandling mod brystkræft.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 701
programme.desc: Efter en voldsom ulykke, hvor Dan falder ned fra et tag og lander på ansigtet, bliver han opereret to gange for at rette op på næsen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Mød Melissa, der faldt i tilbudsfælden på nettet og sidder tilbage med et resultat som hun fortryder inderligt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 406
programme.desc: I dette afsnit møder vi Anita, der vågner op med større bryster, end hun forinden havde aftalt med kirurgen og nu føler sig som en miniudgave af Linse Kessler.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 102
programme.desc: Mød Christina, der ikke fik de struttende silikone bryster hun altid havde drømt om. Mød også Nicole, der hver dag lever med smerter, og Mai, hvis lår er blevet ødelagt af en fedtsugning.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 613
programme.desc: Da sønnen endelig bliver rask, føler Charlott sig ikke længere som sig selv, og hun vælger derfor at forære sig selv en brystforstørrende operation. Men resultatet skuffer.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 505
programme.desc: Efter 2 graviditeter er Majbritt efterladt med to hængende bryster, og hun beslutter derfor at få lavet en brystforstørrende operation. Men drømmen om en fyldig barm er langt fra gået i opfyldelse.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 801
programme.desc: For 25 år siden var Susanne involveret i en voldsom trafikulykke, der skamferer hendes ansigt. Siden ulykken har hun været igennem mere end ti operationer, men føler fortsat, at hun ligner et monster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: I dette program møder vi Dianne, der grundet mistanke om kræft fik fjernet begge sine bryster og i dag har valgt at leve alene, fordi hun skammer sig.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 201
programme.desc: I dag møder vi Dorthe, der har så svært ved slippe sit gamle jeg, at hun har gemt sine infektionsramte implantater.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 605
programme.desc: Da Annika fylder 30 år, får hun sin penge til en skønhedsoperation af sin mand. Parret rejser sammen til Litauen, men allerede på operationsdagen opdager Annika, at den litauiske kirurg ikke gør, hvad de har aftalt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 508
programme.desc: Efter 2 graviditeter er Jeannette ked af sine strækmærker på maven. Lokalpolitikeren Karina sad tilbage med to bryster uden fylde, efter at have ammet sine to børn.
